requirements.statement: Every canonical public operation and reachable component is closed, owner-attributed, internally resolvable, response-complete, and explicitly security-classified; integrity failures have no exception registry.
The canonical public OpenAPI artifact is assembled deterministically from closed, manifest-selected semantic-owner inputs and is the only published OpenAPI contract artifact.

Every candidate public OpenAPI contract is compared with the immutable latest released contract, uses a SemVer increment matching the conservative semantic change class, and matches an exact owner-approved release change set when the diff is nonempty.

The generated operation catalog and contract-backed route binder preserve the canonical public HTTP operation identifiers, owners, methods, paths, response statuses, security alternatives, and declared profile availability.

Every canonical public operation has one semantic owner and one generated availability class, and the active runtime route set exactly matches the base contract plus every claimed profile before the server listens.
